summary: Implemented Issue #7 Python environment isolation: Kernel.spawn now passes only a fixed safe-name allowlist (Windows PATH/SystemRoot/WINDIR/COMSPEC/PATHEXT/SYSTEMDRIVE/USERPROFILE/TEMP/TMP with case-insensitive matching and canonical output; POSIX PATH/HOME/TMPDIR/TEMP/TMP/LANG plus the exact standard LC_* category names; both platforms keep PYTHONIOENCODING/PYTHONUTF8/PYTHONUNBUFFERED/PYTHONPATH), so the child never inherits process.env; no env passthrough or new config was added, any custom python command uses the same filtered env, and the Windows taskkill host spawn is unchanged. Strict TDD: three M2 Issue#7 sentinel/locale/custom-command tests were RED on base f4b7194 before the production change, then 3/3 GREEN; a representative Issue#1 PYTHONPATH/sitecustomize and lifecycle regression set passed 3/3. SECURITY.md, README.md, README.zh-CN.md, docs/architecture.md and docs/architecture.zh-CN.md now document the implemented allowlist and the credential-hygiene-not-sandbox boundary; the live clean-Profile smoke remains NOT_RUN for final M2. The coordinator independently ran the full gates in the same worktree; all passed and are recorded below as coordinator-provided evidence, not as implementer-run commands.

pointers: M2 Issue#7: synthetic credential/proxy sentinels are visible in Host but absent from Python
M2 Issue#7: unknown locale-looking LC_RLM_SECRET_7 is absent while safe startup variables remain usable
M2 Issue#7: explicit custom python command obeys the same filtered env

steps: Added the fixed safe-name allowlist constants and the private collectKernelEnv helper in src/runtime.ts and wired it into Kernel.spawn through the SpawnOptions env field so the Python child no longer inherits process.env; Windows names are matched case-insensitively and emitted in canonical casing, POSIX matches exact LC_* category names with no wildcard, values absent in the host are never synthesised, and no environment value is logged.

Ran strict TDD: appended the three M2 Issue#7 tests first (withHostEnvMap restores every mutated process.env key in finally and only booleans cross back from Python), observed 3/3 FAIL on base f4b7194 because the child inherited the host environment, then implemented the allowlist and observed 3/3 PASS within the focused 30s budget.

Ran the representative Issue#1 pattern (M2 Issue#1 successor: taskkill fallback, shared deadline, late abort) which drives the withPressedKernel PYTHONPATH/sitecustomize injection: 3/3 PASS, confirming PYTHONPATH remains available through the allowlist and the Windows taskkill host spawn is untouched.

Updated SECURITY.md, README.md, README.zh-CN.md, docs/architecture.md and docs/architecture.zh-CN.md to describe the implemented allowlist, the no-env-passthrough policy for custom python commands, the excluded proxy/venv/conda/PYTHONHOME/LD_LIBRARY_PATH/credential variables, and the credential-hygiene-not-sandbox trusted-execution boundary; Issue #7 is retained as historical tracking and V1 scope is not expanded.
